name: Enhanced KYC Verification Workflow
description: Comprehensive KYC verification process with flexible steps including selfie capture, liveness detection, face matching, fuzzy matching, and ID verification

steps.title: Welcome to KYC Verification
steps.description: Welcome to our comprehensive KYC verification process. We'll guide you through each step.
steps.instructions: Welcome the user and explain the KYC verification process. Mention that we'll be capturing their selfie, verifying their identity document, and performing various security checks.

steps.title: Capture Selfie
steps.description: Please capture a clear selfie for identity verification.
steps.instructions: Ask the user to capture a clear selfie. Ensure good lighting, face is clearly visible, and no sunglasses or masks. This will be used for liveness detection and face matching.

steps.title: Liveness Verification
steps.description: Verifying that the selfie is from a live person.
steps.instructions: Automatically perform liveness detection on the captured selfie to ensure it's from a live person and not a photo or video.

steps.title: Personal Information
steps.description: Please provide your basic personal information.
steps.instructions: Collect basic personal information from the user that will be used for verification against their ID document.

questions.question: What is your full name as it appears on your ID document?
What is your date of birth?

steps.title: Upload ID Document
steps.description: Please upload a clear photo of your government-issued ID document.
steps.instructions: Ask the user to upload a clear photo of their government-issued ID document (PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Passport, or Driving License). Ensure all text is readable and the document is not damaged.

steps.title: ID Document Verification
steps.description: Verifying the authenticity of your ID document.
steps.instructions: Automatically verify the authenticity of the uploaded ID document using Digio's verification services.

steps.title: Extract Information from ID
steps.description: Extracting information from your ID document.
steps.instructions: Automatically extract text and structured data from the ID document using OCR technology.

steps.title: Face Matching
steps.description: Matching your selfie with the photo on your ID document.
steps.instructions: Automatically compare the captured selfie with the photo on the ID document to verify they belong to the same person.

steps.title: Name Verification
steps.description: Verifying that the name you provided matches the name on your ID document.
steps.instructions: Automatically compare the name provided by the user with the name extracted from the ID document to ensure they match.

steps.title: Comprehensive Security Check
steps.instructions: Perform a comprehensive verification combining all previous checks to ensure the highest level of security.

steps.title: Verification Complete
steps.description: Your KYC verification has been completed successfully.
steps.instructions: Thank the user and provide a summary of the verification results. Confirm that their KYC process is complete.
